source_photo_points: Stored in deterministic checker and validation report; pixel coordinates derived from actual viewed images.

view_conventions: Photos001/003/007 corroborate opposite/oblique views and seal/bridge topology. Only002 has seven usable bosses for numeric aperture registration;009 provides independent gasket image comparison. Do not invent hidden front-image holes. Homography reverses handedness; physical engine Y reflection tested separately.
projective_vs_similarity: Projective transform corrects image correspondence only. Same original outline uses uniform scale and rigid orientation in feasibility; no projective CAD distortion.
metric_limit: Original source outline also comes from a product photo, not an orthographic measured template. Aperture plane differs from flange plane; systematic parallax is unbounded.

recommended_for_root_review.required_pan_change: Local front seat/terminal corridor must reach these ranges; current pan stations are not moved. This is a proposed coordinated envelope only, not a sealed joint or clamp-load design.
